prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide editorial illustration for a researched book and web profile of experimental filmmaker Pramod Pati. Human Natural mode: Editorial Natural with a quiet poetic quality. Intent: convey playful, patient experimentation with ordinary objects and frame-by-frame movement, not depict an actual historical event or impersonate the filmmaker. Draw an imagined analog animation workbench seen obliquely from above: one anonymous adult's hand enters naturally from the lower left to gently move a small plain wooden cube on a matte work surface; a few simple paper cutouts and a short strip of unlabelled film lie to one side. Part of a modest older film camera on a fixed support is cropped at the far right, looking towards the work area. No face or named person. The cube and its soft contact shadow are the emotional focal point; keep the optical path to the object unobstructed. Medium: confident yet varied charcoal and fine ink line work with restrained watercolor washes on clean ivory paper, muted charcoal, indigo and a small warm red accent. Landscape composition about 3:2, full scene with generous quiet areas and selective rather than uniform detail; purposeful marks, believable hand anatomy and object contact, ordinary materials. No laptop, digital screen, neon, logos, words, captions, faux handwritten text, ornate film reels, manufactured ageing, dramatic cinematic light, decorative cultural symbols, or copies of any existing movie still. This is an original conceptual illustration of analog experimentation, not a documentary reconstruction.
caption: Illustration: ordinary objects, moved one frame at a time.
limitations: Imagined animation workbench, not a portrait of Pramod Pati, his actual studio, a historical event or a copied film still.
visual_review: Root and Drishti inspected: plausible hand-object contact, unobstructed camera direction, paper cutouts and analog materials. No digital tools, false likeness or documentary claim. Distinct from adjacent portraits and Learning Cinema Together illustration.
